items.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: And what happened is that the director, his name was Steve Wolczynski, he had introduced me on the air as “the piano player from The Queens.”

ctx.x: No kidding. I’ll be darned. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -5-

And what happened, at that time we still had a faculty instructor. So in his infinite wisdom, not realizing he had broken all the laws of the postal service, Gary mailed me a letter, right? And it says Attention — you know if you get a letter Attention so-and-so, that is the person that’s supposed to open that letter. And what happened is that the director, his name was Steve Wolczynski, he had introduced me on the air as “the piano player from The Queens.” Because there’s only one borough that says “the” before…
Oh he didn’t know your name.
